commentary: Lu, J., & Wang, X. T. Tackling challenges in large language model-based data extraction: A commentary on Jansen et al. (2025). Supplied manuscript BUL-2025-2112R3.
pagination: One-based physical PDF pages in the supplied review file; section headings disambiguate the duplicated manuscript copy.

A.name: Parsing and understanding semi-structured data
A.definition: Preserve and interpret document layouts, reading order, text, digits, formulas, tables and figures.

B.name: Understanding long contexts
B.definition: Locate and combine relevant evidence across long or dispersed contexts, including distractors and non-literal retrieval.

C.name: Arithmetic and symbolic induction
C.definition: Process numbers and symbols, apply numerical operations and derive requested values from reported inputs.

D.name: Complex reasoning
D.definition: Coordinate multiple intermediate steps, including retrieval, tool use, planning, computation and checking.

mapping_status: Authored task/construct interpretation, not empirical evidence of transfer or task success.
A2_rule: Tables and figures (legacy A2) are part of Challenge A, not an additional commentary challenge.
